description.fallback: While looking for his watch in his desk, Jonathan sees Dio out of the corner of his eye, who has stolen the watch and plans to use it for the day. Jonathan feels uneasy, and surmises that he will never see that watch again. Dio notices a Stone Mask hanging on the wall and takes it down to get a closer look.
